features.intro: One ogre acting this turn jumps and lands on their rear, causing a 3 burst shockwave. Each size 1 creature in the area makes a **Might test** or **Agility test**.
features.name: Shockwave

features.body: Each ogre in the encounter [shifts](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to their speed and can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike). If they can, they gang up on the same target rather than picking different targets.
features.name: Bully

features.body: Until the end of the round, each ogre has damage immunity 5 and deals an extra 5 damage with abilities, and heroic abilities that target any ogre have their Heroic Resource cost reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).
features.name: Rampage

flavor: At the start of any ogre's turn, you can spend Malice to activate one of the following features.
name: Ogre Malice
